one_liner: Look up and correctly implement the core LLM-stack equations: norms, attention, RoPE, AdamW, scaling laws, LoRA, and RL losses.

key_terms.definition: Converts a logits vector into a probability distribution via normalized exponentials; the numerically stable form subtracts the max logit before exponentiating.
Language-modeling loss equal to negative log-probability of the target token, computed stably as log-sum-exp of logits minus the target logit.
Exponential of the mean per-token cross-entropy; interpretable as the average number of equally-likely guesses needed to predict the next token.
Normalizes activations by their root-mean-square magnitude without mean-centering or bias, used in Llama-style decoders for speed and stability.
Computes softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k))V; the 1/sqrt(d_k) scaling restores unit variance in the dot products so softmax gradients stay well-behaved.
Rotates query and key vector pairs by an angle proportional to token position, so their dot product depends only on relative position m-n.
Adam optimizer variant that applies weight decay directly to parameters (decoupled from the gradient-based adaptive step), the standard LLM pretraining optimizer.
Compute-optimal relationship L = E + A/N^alpha + B/D^beta showing parameters N and training tokens D should scale roughly equally (~20 tokens per parameter) for fixed compute.
Fine-tuning method that freezes a pretrained weight matrix and adds a trainable low-rank update (alpha/r)BA, drastically cutting trainable parameters and merging with zero inference overhead.
Reinforcement-learning objective that clips the importance-sampling ratio between new and old policy probabilities to a [1-eps, 1+eps] band, preventing destructively large policy updates.
Critic-free RL method that computes advantages by normalizing each response's reward against the mean and standard deviation of a sampled group of responses to the same prompt.
Closed-form preference-tuning loss that increases the reference-relative log-probability of preferred over dispreferred completions, without a separate reward model or RL rollout.
